product_one_liner.value: Karbon is a collaborative practice-management platform for accounting firms that brings client communications, workflows, tasks, billing, and team collaboration together in one place.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering writing appears within Karbon Magazine rather than a separate engineering-branded blog: both posts are by VP of Engineering Dom Millar and describe the product-building process, technical design, scoping, and shipping features.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: Senior AI Systems Engineer, Melbourne.

compliance_certs.notes: GDPR compliance is also claimed, but described as self-assessed rather than a certification. ISO 27001 is explicitly not independently certified; PCI DSS certification refers to Stripe, not Karbon.

last_funding.notes: The funding database identifies the September 18, 2023 round as Series B-II and rounds its amount to $10.5 million; the SEC filing reports $10,499,989 sold.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is September 2023, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live postings include Account Executive – Mid Market and Business Development Representative.

launched_6mo.notes: Kai, an AI coworker embedded in Karbon, was introduced June 3, 2026, within the window; the announcement states Kai was in early access.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brooke Brockman joined as Chief Marketing Officer in the announcement dated November 11, 2025, within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Marketing operations materials explicitly identify Pardot as the current platform and name Salesforce and Qualified; the account-executive posting names Salesforce, Gong, and Outreach. The marketing-operations advertisement is archived, not an assertion that that role remains open.
